# omniring-research

> The research record behind OMNIRING, a memory that stores small structured records ("marks") in fixed-size high-dimensional vectors and reads them back by resonance.

Setup: `git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/SovRing-Labs/omniring-research && cd omniring-research && python3 -m venv .venv && . .venv/bin/activate && python -m pip install -q numpy && python3 harness/ring1/run_halo.py --quick` (expect: VERDICT:).
Licence: CC BY 4.0.
